answer: Require every agent to submit proof-of-unique-work each epoch: a freshly computed, non-duplicate reasoning artifact that an on-ledger entropy check measures against all prior submissions. Near-copies are rejected before attestation, so a sybil farm cannot press one answer like a marble stamp across a thousand clones. Each fake must independently generate original cognition every round, so the cost is real compute and novel thought per identity, not a single polished pearl reused. Standing accretes slowly, petal by petal like a lotus, only for agents doing genuinely distinct work.
